evidence_quotes: Loteamento ilegal em áreas de mananciais.
Considerou ter havido infração ambiental, consistente no parcelamento irregular do solo, em prejuízo da lei de proteção de mananciais
rationale: This TJSP decision addresses environmental liability of a private developer, the municipality and the state for an irregular land subdivision (loteamento ilegal) inside a watershed protection zone (área de proteção de mananciais) in violation of the watershed protection law. Under the calibrated protocol, Brazilian mananciais watershed protection enforcement is classified as WATER under environmental_protection, while strict_service_access_label is marked UNCERTAIN because the dispute concerns land-use enforcement in a manancial zone without direct water utility service access or direct water abstraction/effluent adjudication.
